opening.argument: The video centers on a family farmer describing his work and what he learns in producer meetings. He says he grows vegetables and shares practical information with partners, including what he learns about reaching clients and trade. Bota na Mesa is presented as a Citi Foundation-supported program building food-chain networks for small producers and family agriculture organizations. In that context, the program text and learn-more URL appear to serve as informational outreach for the agricultural project, not a deceptive participation flow. The record supports that limited reading; it does not establish any particular outcome for viewers.

citations.quote: My name is Nelson de Moura Montarroz, family farmer, and I grow vegetables.
I bring information to my partners, we have meetings that happen at least once a month, and everything I learn I pass it on to them, that helps me and also helps them.

Bota na Mesa aims to mobilize the food chain in large urban centers by promoting the creation of a network that favors the inclusion of small producers and family agriculture organizations, fair trade, environmental preservation and food safety.
